question: 促销期净销额占总净销额的比例是多少
sql:
WITH promo_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS promo_net
    FROM fact_sales
    WHERE is_promo = TRUE
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_net
    FROM fact_sales
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN total_net = 0 THEN NULL 
         ELSE promo_net / total_net 
    END AS promo_net_ratio
FROM promo_sales, total_sales

question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了

    SELECT 
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 7 THEN f.qty ELSE 0 END) AS july_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 8 THEN f.qty ELSE 0 END) AS aug_qty
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON f.sku_id = p.sku_id

FROM monthly_sales

question: 各大区净销额及其累计占比，按销额从高到低
sql:
WITH dealer_region AS (
    SELECT d.dealer_id, d.region
    FROM dim_dealer d
),
sales_region AS (
    SELECT dr.region,
           SUM(fs.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales fs
    JOIN dealer_region dr ON fs.dealer_id = dr.dealer_id
    GROUP BY dr.region
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT region,
           net_sales,
           SUM(net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS running_total,
           SUM(net_sales) OVER () AS total_sales
    FROM sales_region
)
SELECT region,
       net_sales,
       running_total / total_sales AS cumulative_share
FROM ranked
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

question: 有多少个终端和单品的铺货组合在2026年8月完全没有销售
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS combo_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.outlet_id, p.sku_id
    FROM dim_outlet o
    CROSS JOIN dim_product p
    WHERE o.is_active = TRUE
      AND p.is_active = TRUE
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM rel_outlet_sku ros
          WHERE ros.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
            AND ros.sku_id = p.sku_id
            AND (ros.delisted_date IS NULL OR ros.delisted_date >= DATE '2026-08-01')
            AND ros.listed_date <= DATE '2026-08-31'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fact_sales fs
          JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key
          WHERE fs.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
            AND fs.sku_id = p.sku_id
            AND dd.year = 2026
            AND dd.month = 8
      )
) t

WITH outlet_sku_status AS (
    SELECT 
        o.outlet_id,
        o.sku_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN o.listed_date <= DATE '2026-08-31' AND (o.delisted_date IS NULL OR o.delisted_date > DATE '2026-08-01') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_listed
    FROM rel_outlet_sku o
    WHERE o.listed_date <= DATE '2026-08-31' AND (o.delisted_date IS NULL OR o.delisted_date > DATE '2026-08-01')
    GROUP BY o.outlet_id, o.sku_id
),
outlet_sku_sales AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        o.outlet_id,
        o.sku_id
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE o.region = '华东区'
      AND d.year = 2026 AND d.month = 8
      AND s.qty > 0
),
base AS (
    SELECT 
        o.outlet_id,
        o.sku_id,
        COALESCE(oss.is_listed, 0) AS is_listed,
        CASE WHEN oss2.outlet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_sales
    FROM dim_outlet o
    CROSS JOIN dim_product p
    LEFT JOIN outlet_sku_status oss ON o.outlet_id = oss.outlet_id AND p.sku_id = oss.sku_id
    LEFT JOIN outlet_sku_sales oss2 ON o.outlet_id = oss2.outlet_id AND p.sku_id = oss2.sku_id
    WHERE o.region = '华东区'
      AND p.is_active = TRUE
)
SELECT 
    SUM(is_listed) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS coverage_rate,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_listed = 1 AND has_sales = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(is_listed), 0) AS sell_through_rate
FROM base

        SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS promo_cost
    FROM fact_sales f
    LEFT JOIN fact_promo_cost pc 
        ON f.date_key = pc.date_key 
        AND f.outlet_id = pc.outlet_id 
        AND f.sku_id = pc.sku_id 
        AND f.dealer_id = pc.dealer_id
    WHERE (YEAR(f.date_key) = 2025 AND MONTH(f.date_key) BETWEEN 7 AND 12)
       OR (YEAR(f.date_key) = 2026 AND MONTH(f.date_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 6)
    GROUP BY period
)
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026H1' THEN promo_cost / NULLIF(sales_amount, 0) END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2025H2' THEN promo_cost / NULLIF(sales_amount, 0) END)) AS fee_ratio_diff
FROM period_metrics
